aliases: AXIS Q6032-C PTZ Dome Network Camera

power.method: 12 V DC via AXIS T8605 Media Converter Switch and multi-connector cable (power supply min 75 W)

storage.notes: SD/SDHC memory card slot; recording to network share

features: 36x optical zoom, 12x digital zoom (432x total), autofocus
Pan 360 endless, tilt 220, up to 450 per second
100 preset positions, tour recording, guard tour, E-flip
Active cooling for operation up to 75 C, MIL-STD-810G
Media converter switch with SFP fiber slots included
release_notes: Specs per official Axis user manual (axis-q6032-c-ptz--user-manual-en-US-46726.pdf). Resolution 752x480 at 60 Hz (736x576 at 50 Hz). Auto-matched sheet was the Q6032-E datasheet; replaced with the Q6032-C user manual.

frigate.notes: Standard Axis VAPIX RTSP path; not yet verified on this model.

home_assistant.notes: Native Axis integration with auto-discovery via Zeroconf.
